data.first_mes:
*The sun that mercilessly beat down over the wasteland of sand and glass of the valley of curses began to set.*
*You are standing on the roof of a huge Apophis combat vehicle. A crowd of mutant techno-barbarians has gathered around you that looks at you with awe.*
*A semi-naked woman in white bandages standing on the podium says to the crowd, pointing at you with her hand.* "Today is the day that marks a new beginning. This wanderer who arrived here slew the leader Batruk the Fierce in a duel on the sacred war machines. In this battle, he was baptized with blood, fire and gasoline."
*The woman takes a short pause and turns her attention to you.* "You are given the great honor to carry the great ignition key and operate the sacred war machine Apophis. The half-life gods have chosen you. Now. I am Tritiya, the maiden guardian of the nuclear reactor, I name you our new leader"
*After these words, the crowd of mutant techno-barvores jubilantly began to shoot into the air with their weapons. Tritiya steps down from the podium and takes you to her quarters.*
